name: Juggling
summary: Keep three or more objects airborne in rhythmic patterns: a meditative, endlessly deep skill that starts with three beanbags.

name: Card Magic
summary: Sleight of hand with a deck of cards: controls, forces and routines that make the impossible happen inches from someone's face.

name: Lock Picking
summary: Locksport: the puzzle of opening pin-tumbler locks without the key, using tension, feel and patience, on locks you own.

gear: Beginner pick set with tension wrenches

safety: Only pick locks you own or have explicit permission to pick, and never a lock that is in use. Owning picks is legal in most places but restricted in some, so check your local laws.

name: Cardistry
summary: The art of card flourishing: cuts, spins and fans performed for pure visual flow rather than deception.

gear: Two or three decks of cards

name: Pen Spinning
summary: Rotate a pen around your fingers in smooth, looping tricks: the ultimate fidget skill you can practise anywhere.

gear: A pen (later, a modded spinning pen)

name: Yo-Yo
summary: Modern string tricks with a bearing yo-yo: binds, slacks and tangles of string that look like magic.

name: Kendama
summary: A Japanese cup-and-ball toy with surprising depth: balance, flow and spike tricks that reward patient repetition.

name: Coin Magic
summary: Vanishes, transpositions and productions with ordinary coins: classic close-up magic that fits in your pocket.

gear: Several large coins (half-dollar size is ideal)

name: Diabolo
summary: Spin a double-cup top on a string between two hand sticks, then launch it skyward and catch it.

gear: Diabolo with hand sticks and string

name: Contact Juggling
summary: Roll a clear acrylic ball over your hands and arms so smoothly that it seems to float in place.

name: Balloon Twisting
summary: Turn long 260 balloons into dogs, swords and crowns in under a minute: a guaranteed hit with kids.

name: Poi Spinning
summary: Swing weighted tethers in weaves, flowers and wall planes, a hypnotic flow art from New Zealand.

name: Devil Sticks
summary: Keep a centre stick flipping and spinning between two hand sticks: a classic circus skill.

name: Unicycling
summary: Balance, pedal and idle on one wheel, then take it off-road, juggle or ride giraffes.

name: Hoop Dance
summary: Waist hooping, then off-body tricks, isolations and multi-hoop flow.

name: Staff Spinning
summary: Spin a contact or double staff around your body in flowing, rotating patterns.

name: Fire Spinning
summary: Light up your poi, staff or hoop for spectacular night-time flow performances.
safety: Master the moves unlit first, wear natural fibres, always have a fire safety person with a damp towel, and spin only where permitted.

name: Stilt Walking
summary: Walk, dance and perform on stilts, from peg stilts to towering parade legs.
safety: Learn with a spotter on flat, clear ground, and practise falling forward onto your knees.

name: Tightrope Walking
summary: Walk a tensioned steel wire with a balancing pole, the classic high-wire art kept low and safe.

name: Footbag (Hacky Sack)
summary: Keep a small bag in the air with your feet, then link stalls, spins and dexterities.

name: Freestyle Football
summary: Keepy-uppies, around-the-worlds and stalls: ball control turned into a performance art.

name: Sport Stacking
summary: Stack and unstack cups in set pyramid sequences as fast as humanly possible.

name: Hand Shadow Puppetry
summary: Make birds, wolves and rabbits come alive on the wall with nothing but your hands and a light.

name: Whistling
summary: Pucker melodies with vibrato, then master the ear-splitting two-finger whistle.

name: Trick Roping
summary: Spin a lasso into flat loops, wedding rings and the Texas skip, the cowboy circus act.

name: Whip Cracking
summary: Crack a bullwhip with clean technique, then try targets, combos and two-handed routines.
safety: Always wear eye protection and a hat, and keep a clear zone of twice the whip's length around you.

name: Flair Bartending
summary: Flip, spin and juggle bottles and tins while you mix: the showman's way to make a drink.

name: Card Throwing
summary: Spin playing cards across the room hard enough to slice fruit, with the classic Thurston grip.

name: String Figures
summary: Cat's cradle and beyond: weave intricate shapes and stories with a single loop of string.

name: Finger Tutting
summary: Geometric hand and finger choreography, all right angles and illusions, set to the beat.

name: Plate Spinning
summary: Spin plates on sticks, toss them between hands and keep a whole row going at once.

name: Object Balancing
summary: Balance brooms, chairs and swords on your chin, nose or fingertip, as street performers do.

name: Ball Spinning
summary: Spin a basketball on your fingertip, then transfer it, tap it and roll it across your arms.

name: Domino Toppling
summary: Build huge chain reactions of thousands of dominoes with walls, spirals and triggers.

name: Paper Airplanes
summary: Fold record-chasing gliders, darts and stunt planes, and learn why they fly.

name: Rubber Band Magic
summary: Make rubber bands jump between fingers and melt through each other, right under people's noses.

name: Napkin Folding
summary: Fold napkins into swans, roses and bishop's hats to make any table look like a fine restaurant.

name: Bar Bets & Science Tricks
summary: Win friendly wagers with impossible-looking tricks using glasses, coins and a little physics.

name: Stone Skipping
summary: Pick the perfect flat stone and the ideal angle to make it skip across the water a dozen times or more.

name: Boomerang Throwing
summary: Throw returning boomerangs in the right wind for clean catches, then try trick catches.

name: Freestyle Frisbee
summary: Nail-delays, brushes and behind-the-back catches, a frisbee turned into flowing tricks.
